flagship_projects.name: Residential & Commercial Property Consultancy – Gurugram
key_points: Operates across residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial property segments in Gurugram
Also offers home construction services with in-house architects and civil contractors

flagship_projects.name: Builderfloor.com
key_points: Founder-run portal to help buyers find builder floor properties
Aims to prevent property fraud and support informed purchasing decisions

flagship_projects.name: Brokerjee.com
key_points: CRM platform for real estate brokers with lead management features
Targeted at agents and brokers to manage client requirements

market_position.positioning_summary: Arora Realtech is a mid-market real estate consultancy in Gurugram with over two decades of experience, positioned on trust, transparency, and local market expertise. It is a founder-led, small-to-mid-sized firm (11–50 employees) serving buyers, sellers, and investors across property types. The brand emphasises reliability and personalised service rather than premium luxury positioning.
differentiators: 20+ years of hyperlocal Gurugram market expertise led by Dr. Arun Arora
Diversified beyond brokerage into home construction, an online property portal (Builderfloor.com), and a broker CRM (Brokerjee.com)
risks_or_weaknesses: Very small team size (11–50 employees) limits scalability and geographic reach
Low digital/social media visibility; limited recent news or press coverage suggests weak brand marketing
Website technology stack (Drupal/PHP) appears dated, which may affect user experience and SEO

linkedin.typical_content: Founder's personal LinkedIn profile shares real estate networking tips and updates about Builderfloor.com and Brokerjee.com; no dedicated company page found.
linkedin.engagement_quality: Minimal public engagement visible; activity appears sporadic with occasional posts.

key_trends: Digital-first property search is dominant — buyers increasingly rely on portals like 99acres, MagicBricks, and NoBroker, making a strong digital presence critical for consultancies.
Video marketing and virtual property tours are growing expectations among property buyers, especially post-COVID.
CRM adoption among small brokerages is rising, with tools like Brokerjee.com addressing this need directly.
Gurugram's real estate market is experiencing sustained demand in residential and commercial sectors driven by IT/corporate expansion.

comparison_to_competitor.summary: No direct competitor was specified. Arora Realtech competes broadly with other local Gurugram consultancies and national portals. Compared to established digital-first brokerages, Arora Realtech has a weaker online presence but compensates with deep local experience and value-added tools like Builderfloor.com and Brokerjee.com.
notes: Unlike aggregator platforms, Arora Realtech offers end-to-end services including construction, which is a differentiator for clients wanting a single point of contact.
The company's limited social media footprint puts it at a disadvantage versus more digitally active competitors in the Gurugram market.
